sources.title: Venezuela MPPRE: adult passport issuance abroad
sources.publisher: Ministry of Popular Power for Foreign Affairs and International Trade of Venezuela
sources.officialityEvidence: Venezuela's current Foreign Ministry service directs an adult Venezuelan to SAIME for passport issuance at the diplomatic mission in the country of residence.
sources.supportingExcerpt: solicita la cita de emisión de pasaporte ante la misión diplomática del país donde se encuentra residencia.

sources.title: Venezuela MPPRE: emergency travel document
sources.publisher: Ministry of Popular Power for Foreign Affairs and International Trade of Venezuela
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Foreign Ministry service describes a separate safe-conduct travel document for Venezuelans returning without a valid Venezuelan passport because it is expired, lost, stolen or damaged.
sources.supportingExcerpt: documento o salvoconducto ... sin pasaporte venezolano válido debido a que este se encuentra vencido, extraviado, hurtado o deteriorado.

sources.title: Venezuela MPPRE: diplomatic and service passport visa-exemption agreement
sources.publisher: Ministry of Popular Power for Foreign Affairs and International Trade of Venezuela
sources.officialityEvidence: The Foreign Ministry's current passport index identifies agreements limited to diplomatic and service passports, confirming those special-document routes are not transferred to the standard adult passport service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: pasaportes diplomáticos y de servicio ... por un período no superior a 90 días.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina FIPA: visa information for visitors
sources.publisher: Foreign Investment Promotion Agency of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Foreign Investment Promotion Agency page is published on the Council of Ministers' gov.ba domain and lists Venezuela among citizens who do not require a visa to enter Bosnia and Herzegovina.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A) Citizens of the following countries do not require a visa to enter Bosnia and Herzegovina: ... 64) Venezuela.

sources.title: Service for Foreigners' Affairs: stay of aliens in Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.publisher: Service for Foreigners' Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current competent Service for Foreigners' Affairs guidance says the Decision on Visas determines the visa-free country list and states the statutory visa-free stay limit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa-free aliens may enter and stay up to 90 days over a six-month period.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document makes F5A tourism available to citizens of all countries and provides electronic delivery of the visa certificate.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The institutional Government page identifies equatorialguinea-evisa.com as the operational visa site and says interested visitors can obtain a visa online without attending in person.
sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live eligibility and electronic delivery translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain currently serves its live English translation asset. It states that all nationalities can apply and that eVisas are emailed and downloadable as PDF.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E- Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live regular-passport translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain's live English asset limits the eVisa application to the regular passport used for travel and excludes other travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

policies.title: Venezuelan ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Bosnia and Herzegovina government guidance lists Venezuela in the general visa-free rule and states an up-to-90-days-in-180-days stay limit.
conditions: Use the regular Venezuelan passport issued through SAIME/Foreign Ministry adult-passport service. Current BiH government guidance lists Venezuelan citizens as visa-exempt and sets the general visa-free stay at up to 90 days in 180 days.
This does not establish employment, residence, diplomatic, service, emergency travel document, identity-document, carrier or final-admission treatment.

policies.title: Venezuelan ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service accepts citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Use the regular Venezuelan passport issued through SAIME/Foreign Ministry adult-passport service. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days, with the stated passport-validity and supporting-document requirements.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current all-country document does not identify a Venezuelan ordinary-passport exception; this classification is medium confidence. Work, residence, diplomatic, service, emergency, identity and other special documents, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the Venezuelan ordinary passport and required tourism documents.
Pay and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and required documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Venezuelan ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's institutional Government page authenticates its online visa service; the live translation asset on that exact domain accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF.
conditions: Apply using the regular Venezuelan passport issued through SAIME/Foreign Ministry adult-passport service; the live official translation asset excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload the required visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not an ETA or visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register and submit the visitor eVisa application with the Venezuelan ordinary passport to be used for travel.
Pay online and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record and meet entry-point and final-admission conditions.
